slots.name: total death toll
slots.sentence: The total death toll from Israeli attacks since the start of the war in Gaza three years ago now stands at more than 74,000, according to the Gaza health ministry.

slots.name: deaths since ceasefire
slots.sentence: She is among more than 1,400 people in Gaza who have been killed in Israeli attacks since the start of the ceasefire on 10 October last year, according to Gaza's Hamas-run health ministry, whose figures are considered reliable by the UN.

slots.name: children killed since ceasefire
slots.sentence: He is one of more than 300 children killed since the start of the ceasefire, according to Gaza's health ministry.

slots.name: Israeli soldiers killed since ceasefire
slots.sentence: At least seven Israeli soldiers have been killed in Gaza since the start of the ceasefire.

slots.name: Gaza population
slots.sentence: Most of Gaza's 2.1 million population has been displaced multiple times by the war, the UN says, with many forced to live in tented cities and unsafe structures.

slots.name: Hamas controlled area
